Outline of applied science
The following
outline
is provided as an overview of and topical guide to applied science:
Applied science
–
the branch of
science
that applies existing scientific knowledge to develop more practical applications, including inventions and other technological advancements. Science itself is the systematic enterprise that builds and organizes
knowledge
in the form of
testable
explanations
and
predictions
about the
universe
.
